Welcome to the Department of Statistics, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan!
The Department of Statistics was established in 2015 under the Faculty of Physical and Numerical Sciences of the Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan to meet the demand of producing quality students having technical and data analytical skills who can play an important role in the socio-economic development of the country.
Since its inception, the Department of Statistics has been playing a pivotal role in teaching and research in the University and has also develop industrial linkages. It has a remarkable reputation, running strongly demanding programs of graduate and undergraduate studies in Statistics and Data Science. We offer both undergraduate and graduate degree programs that include BS-4 years, MSc-2 years, MPhil and PhD in Statistics. Our undergraduate program offers a broad range of courses, covering theory, computations and applications. Statistics, being inter-disciplinary, applied and computational as a discipline, motivates us to train our students and provide them the opportunity to solve real-world problems. Furthermore, we also provide consultancy services and training to graduate and undergraduate students from other departments of the University.
The department has a rich and highly experienced faculty with diverse research interests in several areas of statistics, including robust statistics, machine learning, biostatistics, computational statistics and time series analysis. The Department of Statistics is committed and striving to impart quality education, achieve academic excellence in teaching, research and scholarly endeavors.
To learn more about the department, academic programs, its faculty and their research interests, I invite you to navigate through our webpage of the Department of Statistics.
Dr. Umair Khalil
Chairman, Department of Statistics
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
